home.title: Latest
home.lede: The newest published articles. Each one links to its page and to its tags.

tags.title: Tags
tags.lede: Every tag, with how many published articles carry it.

tag.lede: Published articles carrying this tag, newest first.

articles.title: Articles
articles.lede: Rendered server-side from a compiled template. The filter posts over htmx and swaps only the list; with JavaScript off the same form posts the whole page.
articles.empty: No published articles yet. Sign in to the admin and create one -- a Draft or an Archived article will not appear here.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.lede: The admin is for the operator. Enter the passphrase from this host's secrets.env.

hero.title: Server-rendered HTML, one native binary
hero.lede: This is the NativeWeb reference application: Minimal APIs, compiled templates, HTMX for the parts that move, and a single self-contained AOT executable. Everything below is rendered on the server.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lede: A plain form that sends one email through the framework mail seam. Bot traps and an antiforgery token guard it; neither is written here by hand.
contact.name: Your name
contact.sent: Thank you. Your message was sent. We will reply to
contact.unsent: Your message could not be sent just now. Nothing was lost -- please try again later.
contact.incomplete: Every field is required, and the email address has to look like one.

upload.title: Upload a picture
upload.lede: One file, bound by the same declarative binder as a text field. The size ceiling and the accepted types are declared beside the field, not checked by hand in the handler.
upload.caption: Caption
upload.limits: Up to 1 MB, as PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP.
upload.failed: That picture could not be stored. Nothing was written.
upload.full: This sample holds a limited number of pictures and is full. Nothing was written.

survey.title: A two-step survey
survey.lede: The first step’s answer is carried into the second in one signed hidden field. Nothing is kept on the server between the two.

step2.title: A two-step survey: step two
step2.lede: Step one’s answer came back with this page and goes out with your next submit.
step2.hint: Submitting this twice records two responses. It is not idempotent and does not pretend to be.

done.title: Thank you
done.lede: Both steps arrived together, which is the whole of what the carried field buys.
done.count: Responses recorded since this process started:

survey.absent: That form arrived without its first step. Please start again.
survey.altered: That form could not be read back. Please start again.
survey.expired: That form sat too long and its carried answer has expired. Please start again.
